description: Pre-release de test pour le patch Keepcool 1.8.21 « booking availability dots ». Inclut les correctifs J+30 et e-mail existants dans le bundle. Candidat à valider sur téléphone ; ne pas considérer comme release stable.

patches.name: Keepcool: 30-day booking calendar
patches.description: Show and allow booking from today through J+30. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.

patches.name: Keepcool: allow plus in email
patches.description: Allow + in the local email part without changing the input or login request. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.

patches.name: Keepcool: booking availability dots
patches.description: Show a green dot on calendar dates having at least one booking slot with a free place. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.
